content: Dule-niaburba-ichesur-nikad nudaklesad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala mata-dummad-gaka-obakar Gadaraʼye-neg-nugadse modapmalad.
Jesús urgi-aidedgu, dule-gwensak-niaburba-nikad, neg-uan-imbaba e-abin noalid.
A-dule neg-uangi gudiid. Dule geg gaed, esgoro-dubginbela geg edillebalid.
Bukidargus esgoro-dubgi e-nag, degi, e-argan edindanigusmalanad, degi-inigwele, esgoro-dub iid-iid imakdaed. Gaega, dule gangued nikasulid.
Dule-niaburba-nikad mutikidba, ibginedba, yala-imbaganba, neg-uan-imbaba binnasur gordii, degi, na dukin akwagi sarsodii daed.
Bannaba-Jesús-daksagua, abarmakalid, Jesús-asabin yokorgi-sindigar signonikid.
Geb binnasur-gote, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Jesús-Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Machi. ¡Mer be ibgwensur an-sao! Bab-Dummad-nuggi mer be ise-mesagwar an-imake.
Ar ade, Jesús weyob niaburbaga sogdegusad: “Niaburba, dulegi-be-maid be noe.”
Jesús a-dulese egichialid: —¿Igi be nuga? Dule, abin-sogded: —Bukidaradye an nuga, ar ade, anmar niamar-ichesulid.
Niamar Jesúsʼgi gannar-gannar wilenai gusad, mer be dikasur anmar-barmidye.
Deunni, sinmar-bukidar yar-naba mas-mananaid.
Niaburbamar Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad, ega sogdemalad: —Anmar, sinmargi-ubogega, sinmar-bukwadse be anmar-barmide.

Degisoggu, Jesús, sinmar-bukwadse niaburbamar-barmisad. Niaburbamar dulegi-nodmargua, sinmargi ubodapid. Sinmar-milibo-yar-wereged-naba-bukwadi (2,000), mata-dummadse babatidapid, bela sinmar gundilegar burgwismalad.
Sin-edarbemalad dobguar duurmakdemalad. Neggweburgi, degi, sapurba-negmar-bubukwadgi, bela ibmar-gusad sogdapmalad. Geb dulemar degi-neggusad daknadmarsunnad.
Jesúsʼse nonimargua, dakarmalad, dule-nia-bukidar-nika-gudidaed sii. Mor-yoi, degi, nugus-sii dakarmalad. Dulemar dobe itodmalad.
Dulemar-we-ibmar-daksamalad, dulemar-daksasurmaladga sogsamalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusad igi nugusa, degi, igi sinmar mata-dummadse bela babatisbali.
Geb Gadara-dulemar Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad, we-yargi-be-gudiid be naye.
Jesús urgi nainagu, dule-nia-nika-gudigusad, Jesúsʼba-naega Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad.
Jesús eba-dagega imaksasulid, ega sogded: —Be-negse, be-gwenadganse be nae, Bab-Dummad bela bega ibmar-imaksad be sogna, degi, igi nue-wile be-daksabali be sogbalo.
Degisoggu, dule-niaburba-nika-gudigusad nadsunnad. Geb Decápolis-yargi-neggweburmar-bukwadgi igi-Jesús e-nudaksagusa, sogdii gualid. Bela dulemar geger dakmalad.
Jairo-bunolo, degi, ome boni-nalur-nikad
Jesús gannar urgi mata-dummad-gaka-baidse obaksabargu, a-mata-gaka-naba besad, ar ade, dulemar-bukidar e-dikarba bukunonimalad.
Geb degine, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-daked-e-dummad-wargwen, Jairoʼye-nugad, Jesúsʼse nonikid. Jesús-dakargu, yokorgi sindigar Jesús-asabin signonikid.
Jesúsʼgi nue-wilenaigusad, ega sogded: —An-bunagwa burgwedani maid. Anba be dage, be-argan egi be mesdage, adi, nuguegar, degi, mer burgwegar.
Jesús Jairoʼba nadegusad. Dule-bukidar eba nadmarmogad, ali-ali Jesúsʼgi yolenanai guarmalad.
Dulemar-nadapmalad-abargi ome-gwensak birgambe-gakabogus (12) boni-nalur-nika-gudiid nadap gusmogad.
A-ome, ina-duleganse nue-san-odurdakledii gusad. Aisaar nuguoeyob, bela mani-nikad binsa inadurgangi misgusad. Aka bur bule ega bonigan burgumai gualid.
Ome-boni-nikad Jesúsʼgi sunmakmar-itoargu, emar-abargi, Jesús-yarganba nonikid, degi, e-ibe e-mordummad ebusad.
Ar ome binsaed: “Unnila an e-mordukubi wis-ebusale, an yog-nuguar naoed.”
Ome Jesús-e-morduku-ebusgu, yog-nuguar naded. Geb ome na magasaila itosad, ede nugusa.
Jesús magar itosmogad egi gangued node, degisoggu, dulemarsik yog-aibiris imaksad, geb egisded: —¿Doa an-mor ebusa?
E-sapingan, abin-sogded: —Be dake, dule-bukidar ali-ali begi yolenanaid, degite, be egisde, ¿doa an ebusye?
Jesús nue-nuu e-dikarba-bukmalad-dakdegu, aminagusad, doa e-ebusa.
Ome e-san-nugusad mag itossoggu, dobe-itogedba ise-wawanmakar Jesús-asabin yokorgi sindigar signonikid. Geb Jesúsʼga bela napiragwadgi ibmar sogsad.
Jesús omega sogded: —Bunor, ar be Bab-Dummadgi bengussursoggu, be nugussun. Be gwage-bogidikidgi nae, degi, be-bonigan bela bei bergussun.
Jesús amba sunmakgwichidgine, dulemar Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-daked-e-dummad-Jairo-neggi-danimalad, Jairoʼga sognonimalad: —Be-bunolo burgwisa, ¿ibiga bar be odurdaked-sailagi wilenai?
Jesús deyob-dulemar-soge itosgu, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-daked-e-dummad-Jairoʼga sogded: —Mer be bukib-binsae, unnila mer be bengue.
Jesús, dule-bamalad eba-naed imaksasulid. Unnila Pedro, Jacobo, degi, Jacobo-urba-Juan, amarbi eba-naed imaksad.
Jairo-negse modapmargu, Jesús dulemar-dakdapid bela oimakbukwa, bobukwa, degi, binnasur gorbukwa.
Jesús negyaba dogdegu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar oimakbukwa, degi, bobukwa? Bunolo burgwar maisulid, unnila gabmaid.
Jesús-deyob-soge-itosmargu, dulemar bela egi dododmalad. Geb Jesús bela dulemar-bukwad-oniega imaksad. Geb bia bunolo maidse, unnila bunolo-e-bab, e-nan, degi, eba-nadapmaladbi dogega imaksad.
Jesús, argangi bunolo-gasgu, Arameo-e-gayaba bunologa sogded: —¡Talita-cumi! A sogleged: “Bunolo an bega soge, be gwisgu.”
Jesús weyob ega sogsagu, bunolo birgambe-gakabo-nikad (12) yog-gwisguar imaksad, geb yog nanaaled. Dulemar bunolo-durgus-daksagu, geger dakmalad.
Jesús dulemar-bukwadga ise-binnasur sogsad, mer bipisaale dulemar-baiganga bunolo-durgusad sogmaloye. Geb masgi bunolo-ogunmalaga imaksad.
